entry_points.text: Fault fixup reinstalls initial image; VM exit syncs disable vector from MSR_IA32_XFD when dynamic with interrupts off.

exports.text: Early boot exposes a single PCI quirk scan entry and a global stolen graphics range written once then treated read-only.
FPU core exposes restore from saved state for a mask, save of live registers with widest mechanism, and an interrupt-context usability query.
Guest lifecycle, enable, update, sync and swap; bidirectional portable conversion; kernel entry establishes clean controls, with sync, activation, fault reset and component address lookup.

hazards.text: Early config and MMIO run unlocked assuming single-threaded boot and successful mapping; serial timeout still writes and newline doubles output; firmware values trusted within clamps.
Disabled presence cleared when non-resident to avoid host faults; confidential images refresh disable only relying on protected memory.

invariants.text: Bus-zero scan at boot when permitted matches vendor/device with wildcards and masked class, honors once-only bits 1, 2 and union, recurses bridges and stops single-function; remapping marked broken by revision; one platform disables timer.

TSEG and memory sizing gated by enable with fixed sizes; stolen base per generation via subtraction, scaled top plus segment, or masked register; size via tables, linear steps or piecewise formulas for listed families with paired helpers; graphics reservation runs once, stores range and marks firmware map.

Default baud 9600, divisor 115200/baud, legacy bases 3F8/2F8; port parsing tolerates comma, hex base or indexed ttyS; hardware sets 8N1, disables irq/FIFO, asserts handshake, programs divisor; MMIO needs hex base, maps one page, honors nocfg; PCI parses bus:slot.func, checks class, enables BAR, maps low32 assuming low space; registration rejects duplicate index; output polls bounded then writes.

Firmware reservation runs once, skipped for paravirt, converts KB size word at 413, clamps to 9F000, lowers for EBDA, reserves to 1M; EISA probes 4B at FFD9 once with guest skips; ESPFIX addresses fold page/slot with random offsets preserving low16; boot and per-CPU paths skip when unsupported or already set, safe to repeat.

Validity needs owner plus CPU match; lifecycle invalid until restore plus activation, cleared on deactivate; user restore skips kernel threads, restores except keys, activates and clears pending; restore syncs disable, intersects mask, splits halves; save prefers xsave then fxsave then legacy with reload; NMI warns and denies; low restores use fixup wrapper; large vector use refreshes timing; faults use fixups.

Kernel save writes full mask XFEATURE_MASK_FPSTATE split halves, warns on fault and before patching; primitive patches variants, clears error, fixups faults; permissions freeze on first guest, inherit under signal lock; sizing from defaults plus aligned displacement; dynamic enable checks allowance, snapshots extents; realloc unions enable, clears disable, publishes atomically; raw address needs enable plus compaction; inbound requires allowance, uncompacted, zero pad, legal controls; shadow stack stores pointer; save area has legacy, header and extended with gaps zeroed; bad frees and missing areas defensive.

locks.text: ESPFIX mutex guards first creation with double-checked share; group signal lock guards allowances; realloc publication runs under register serialization.

state_machines.text: Timer0 exits if forced, else derives revision, skips below 82 or when swap clear via indexed ports; timer1 fixes polarity at 40+, exits at 39+, else checks swap; wireless on Apple only restores D0, maps window, waits idle, pulses reset, unmaps; VGA keeps 80x25 cursor, scrolls, handles newline/return/wrap, writes assume identity map.

Option scan runs once testing each position for keep, serial, mmio32, ttyS, pciserial, vga, debug, hypervisor and cross-debug, runs initializer and registers console; table creation allocates missing upper then middle levels with restricted clones, maps stack read-only, publishes and records addresses.
Hypervisor swap exchanges task/guest images toggling activity with full restore or disable-only for confidential; dynamic enablement verifies allowances then replaces record.
Export emits selected presence with legacy pieces then extended components in order; import validates then copies components merging presence.

structs.text: Quirk entry holds vendor, device, class, mask, flags and callback; gfx bundle pairs base and size helpers; serial console named earlyser with write hook and negative unregistered index; serial uses base 3F8, offsets 0-6, ready 0x20, latch 0x80; wireless window 16K at cap 0x40; KB 1024, MB nested.
Per-CPU fixup and writable addresses; table length and sizing from 64B stacks, shifts and CPU count; clones span 65536 with restricted no-write no-exec protections and zeroed stack pages.

Config and initial blocks read-only after boot; per-CPU owner, kernel-use flag, disable state and size key; record links task pointer, activity, alloc/guest/confidential marks, extents, enable maps, disable vector, allowances and CPU/pending.
